name: found you
source:
Aster's always been a scaredy cat, so when Noel's game of one man hide-and-seek goes terribly wrong without his knowledge, Aster's stuck hiding in his bathtub—hiding from whatever it is that's parading around as Noel.

[from [url=https://fuwawuri.itch.io/found-you]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿斯特從小膽子就小。諾埃爾背著他玩起「一個人的捉迷藏」，還出了大事。這下阿斯特只得縮在浴缸裡，躲著外面那個頂著諾埃爾的模樣晃來晃去、不知究竟是什麼的東西。

［摘自[url=https://fuwawuri.itch.io/found-you]itch.io[/url]］
